name: Agenda
description: Online appointments, simple for you and your customers: services with their weekly hours, a booking calendar for your pages that shows only free times, confirmations with the calendar file, reminders, and links to cancel or move without an account. With an admin calendar, CSV export and importers from Simply Schedule Appointments and Booking Calendar. 30 bookings in the free version; Agenda Pro takes as many as you need.
author: Cleitext
